overview: Join our friendly nurse-led care team in Crieff, Strathearn, and surrounding Perthshire communities. Make a rewarding difference every day providing kind, person-centred home care to local clients with flexible hours, industry-leading hourly pay (£14.50 - £16.50/hr), and full paid training.
responsibilities: Supporting clients with morning and evening routines, personal care, and washing
Medication prompting and assistance under nurse guidance
Preparing nutritious meals and encouraging hydration
Warm companionship, social interaction, and checking in on wellbeing
Light domestic tasks, tidying, and maintaining a comfortable home
Assisting with appointments and local shopping trips around Crieff
whatWeOffer: £14.50 to £16.50 per hour with enhanced holiday pay
Full paid training, induction, and shadowed shifts
SSSC registration support and fully funded SVQ qualifications
Generous mileage allowance (45p/mile) and paid travel time
Flexible shift patterns (mornings, evenings, weekends, or zero-hours)
Free uniform and full PPE kit provided
24/7 on-call nurse clinical guidance and support
requirements: A kind, caring nature with genuine empathy for others
Reliable, punctual, and good communication skills
Valid UK Driving Licence and access to a car is preferred for rural Perthshire rounds
Right to work in the UK
No prior care experience required — complete training provided
